records.verified_title: HOPPER: Learnable Hop Extraction for Linearized Graph Sequence Models
records.verified_operation: One graph/hop-conditioned extractor supplies hop-state sequences to a per-node sequence processor. Hypernetwork emits finite-memory A/D/I recurrence coefficients; output-only feature attention/LayerNorm leave recurrent structural states unnormalized.
records.graph_specific_failure: Fixed propagation or early compressed states can force a downstream processor to compensate for poorly transported long-range information; adjacency/nonbacktracking hop extraction is an explicit special-case baseline.
records.strong_single_comparator: Same graph and hop-state information in one competent HOPPER extractor/sequence model, including initial-hop and raw-feature skips.
records.sharing_boundary: Shared downstream heads cannot recover distinctions absent from the complete common input. Privatizing extraction moves the intervention upstream and adopts a known single-model operation.
records.source_qualification: The graph summary depends on initial H, so coefficient-conditioned state linearity is not global linearity in H. Appendix B stability/implementation details and all theorem proofs/results remain uninspected.
records.figure_scope: Selected captions only; no figure pixels inspected

records.verified_operation: Directed-edge hidden states exclude reverse-edge messages in Eq3; initialization encodes endpoints/edge features; final node prediction pools incoming and outgoing states. Degree-one exception permits begrudging backtracking. Eq5 gives NBA-GCN.
records.graph_specific_failure: Reincorporated reverse-edge messages create redundant walk contributions and obscure newly reached information in message aggregation.
records.strong_single_comparator: One competently trained NBA-GNN with identical directed-edge states, input information, depth and edge-state computation. An information-preserving raw/hop skip can also defeat the restricted witness.
records.sharing_boundary: An ensemble downstream of the same lossy graph representation cannot repair lost path information. Multiple upstream cavity trajectories change the architecture and paid graph work, with no demonstrated sharing-specific advantage.
records.source_qualification: Motivation and proposition statement inspected; no proof certified, no results or implementation source read. Title is bound to v1 HTML and is not treated as a separate identity from plural metadata title.
